name: marginals_selected

provenance.adversarial_semantics: Every update: prior and encoded-state fake paths averaged; labeled complete and all-record action-hidden joint views averaged; mask fixed context and structural input mask; no synthetic cycle
provenance.normalization: Shared state scaler fit all available training states/successors; action scaler fit labeled actions only
provenance.initialization: All E/G1/G2/G3/prior parameters freshly initialized; no pretrained model weights
provenance.loss_reductions: action: mean squared standardized error over labeled batch x 2; each state: mean squared standardized error over batch x 6 + mean BCE logits over batch x 2; sum three weighted heads + default MoG prior regularizer once + adversarial_weight*(joint + marginal_weight*mean three marginals); D=sumroles; each role averages its views and fake paths

training.selection: Deferred: highest validation landing fraction, tie-break mean return
training.control_input: Current observed state plus terrain; no current/previous action or successor input
training.initialization: All E/G1/G2/G3/prior parameters freshly initialized; no pretrained model weights

checkpoint_provenance.normalization: Shared state scaler fit all available training states/successors; action scaler fit labeled actions only
checkpoint_provenance.initialization: All E/G1/G2/G3/prior parameters freshly initialized; no pretrained model weights
checkpoint_provenance.loss_reductions: action: mean squared standardized error over labeled batch x 2; each state: mean squared standardized error over batch x 6 + mean BCE logits over batch x 2; sum three weighted heads + default MoG prior regularizer once + adversarial_weight*(joint + marginal_weight*mean three marginals); D=sumroles; each role averages its views and fake paths

expert_diagnostics.scope: Historical held-out expert behavior transitions; secondary diagnostics only
expert_diagnostics.action_target: Recorded expert current command; never provided to the state encoder

on_policy_diagnostics.scope: Predictions at learner-visited measured states versus actual successors under learner actions; transition-weighted
on_policy_diagnostics.action_target: Recorded learner command: numerical replay consistency, not expert agreement

timing_scope: E + G2 + MoG routing/offset diagnostics; auxiliary heads scored offline

gan_eligibility.evidence: Known GAN source/archive, every-step GAN count, finite discriminator weights changed from initialization
